name: MvPolynomial.taylor_rename
source:
theorem taylor_rename {τ : Type*} (f : σ → τ) (α : τ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    taylor α (rename f P) = rename f (taylor (α ∘ f) P) := by
  simp [taylor, rename_eq_aeval, comp_aeval_apply]
